Class Record.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.Record.Builder
Enclosing class:
Record
public static final class Record.Builder extends Object
Fluent builder for constructing Record definitions.

Mirrors the hierarchical structure of COBOL's DATA DIVISION, using method chaining and lambdas for group nesting.
